trello.name: Renew wildcard SSL and internal CA certificates with auto-renewal
trello.desc: Renew and deploy wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com and rotate internal CA certificate that signs service mesh. Set up auto-renewal to prevent manual annual renewal cycles. Both certificates should be handled in same change window before public cert expiry to maintain buffer and service mesh trust continuity. Deploy renewed wildcard cert to load balancers and configure cert-manager for auto-renewal for both public and internal certs. Internal CA cert expires two weeks after public cert, so renewal window is shared with public cert renewal by August 22nd, well before September 1st expiry of wildcard cert. Owner is Ben. Acceptance criteria: wildcard cert renewed and deployed to load balancers, internal CA cert rotated, cert-manager configured for auto-renewal for both certs, no manual renewal required going forward. Notes: buffer requested before September 1st expiry; same window for both certs as per Yuki instruction.

trello.name: PDF export for reports feature
trello.desc: Implement end-to-end PDF export for reports to address customer requests. Backend renders report to PDF using headless Chrome. Frontend adds export button with progress state for large reports that take a few seconds. Aisha owns both backend and frontend halves of the deliverable as splitting is not sensible. Target completion is end of month. As part of delivery, record a short demo GIF for marketing changelog. Owner is Aisha. Acceptance criteria: backend PDF rendering service operational with headless Chrome, frontend export button visible and functional with progress indication, reports generated correctly, demo GIF recorded and provided for changelog. Notes: single task with two halves, demo GIF folded into same task, not a separate item.

trello.name: Staging environment parity with production
trello.desc: Resolve staging drift where staging is three migrations behind production, which is burning QA. Immediately run the three pending migrations on staging today to bring schema in line with production. Implement a nightly job that diffs staging schema against production schema and posts an alert to the infra channel if divergence is detected. Owner is Ben. Acceptance criteria: three pending migrations applied to staging today, nightly schema diff job created and running, infra channel receives divergence notifications when schemas differ. Notes: both immediate remediation and ongoing prevention in one item.
